ladder: settled on being rid of us

body.text: Something has changed with the {param:tribe}. I cannot put a date on it, but the men who go out to the edge of the fields come back quieter than they went.
They are {perception:their_humour}, as near as I can judge it. Nobody has been hurt. Nobody has been welcomed either, and they used to be.
I would rather ask you now what you would have me do than write to you after, when there is less choice in it.

options.text: and have read it with care
and would rather not have needed it

options.label: be ready for them
options.text: Be ready for them. If it comes to nothing, you have a stockade and I have wasted some timber.

options.label: trade with them, and keep trading
options.text: Trade with them. Men who are doing business are slow to do anything else.

options.label: keep to your own ground
options.text: Keep to your own ground and make the most of it. Give them nothing to point at.
